LESSON: MY CREATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: My Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about My Creation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 3 lessons
2. draw the family tree to understand relationships within the family

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 3 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 3 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. draw the family tree to understand relationships within the family
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to draw the family tree to understand relationships within the family. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about My Creation.
2. Explain My Creation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My Creation.
4. Show that you can: name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 3 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My Creation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is My Creation important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 3 lessons
2. draw the family tree to understand relationships within the family

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
